spec.name: Porsche 911 GT3 R (992)
spec.notice: Dati dimensionali Porsche 2026; potenza e massa dipendono dal BoP. Rapporti, coppia, aero, gomme e tarature sono stime del simulatore, non dati di omologazione WEC.

derivations.tyreRadii: Nominal 68/71 cm outside diameter divided by two. Not a measured effective rolling radius.
derivations.width: 2.050 m maximum of published front 2.039 m / rear 2.050 m.

algorithms.body: SI planar Newton/Euler, four body/yaw contact velocities, wheel angular dynamics at 240 Hz, fixed 60 Hz episode tick.
algorithms.tyres: Estimated combined-slip tanh force circle, implicit monotonic wheel solve; load/thermal/pressure/wear sensitivity. Not measured Michelin Pacejka coefficients.
algorithms.shifts: RPM-only automatic sequential assist or diagnostic manual request; finite torque cut, neutral, reverse, overrev protection.
algorithms.aids: Own estimated per-wheel ABS and rear-slip TC. Not Bosch Generation 5 software.
algorithms.suspension: Quasi-static load transfer plus sprung-body pitch/roll spring-damper response on flat ground; not full 3D wheel suspension.
algorithms.learning: 28 sensor channels, 202 trainable parameters, actions/recurrent propagation at 10 Hz. Manual vehicle interventions excluded from training and champions.

boundaries: Power/base weight depend on BoP; no event-specific BoP supplied. Driver/fuel mass is added by model choice, not a claimed homologated running weight.
Lap lengths calibrated to official references by uniform map conversion. Actual local widths, radii, elevation and track surface are not surveyed.
No other-car contacts or aerodynamic wake. Wall contact terminates the episode, not deformable crash/rebound simulation.
No measured tyre/engine/aero/damper calibration, full 3D suspension, bumps, physical curb elevations, weather, damage, sound or pit strategy.
Official subset export metadata records historical 22 sensor channels. New six powertrain channels are runtime measurements, not newly identified anatomical sensory mappings.
Loading 166700 neurons does not mean updating them all simultaneously: original sparse 8192-slot budget and two recurrent passes retained.
